scenes.title: The coil creates a changing field
Field in the coil, heat in the pan

vo.text: This pan heats on an induction cooktop without a directly heated burner.
vo.speak: This pan heats on an induction cooktop without a directly heated burner.

vo.text: The cooktop sends energy into the pan using a changing magnetic field.
vo.speak: The cooktop sends energy into the pan using a changing magnetic field.

vo.text: Below the glass, high-frequency alternating current flows through a copper coil.
vo.speak: Below the glass, high-frequency alternating current flows through a copper coil.

vo.text: That field drives circular electric currents inside the magnetic metal pan.
vo.speak: That field drives circular electric currents inside the magnetic metal pan.

vo.text: Electrical resistance turns their energy into heat, so the pan itself gets hot.
vo.speak: Electrical resistance turns their energy into heat, so the pan itself gets hot.

vo.text: The pan then conducts that heat into the food.
vo.speak: The pan then conducts that heat into the food.

vo.text: A suitable magnetic pan is essential; ordinary glass or copper alone will not work.
vo.speak: A suitable magnetic pan is essential; ordinary glass or copper alone will not work.

vo.text: So the coil creates the field, but the resistant pan becomes the heater.
vo.speak: So the coil creates the field, but the resistant pan becomes the heater.
